LTXLoraStackAV.name: LTXLoraStackAV
LTXLoraStackAV.description: Stack up to 12 LoRAs onto an LTX2 model with separate audio and video block-group scaling per LoRA. Replaces a chain of LoRA Loader Advanced nodes. Per-layer effective strength is: strength × (audio_weight if layer is audio else video_weight). Audio classification: keys containing 'audio' substring (catches audio_attn, audio_ff, audio_adaln, both cross-attention directions, and the audio embeddings connector). Set num_loras to control how many slots are actually used — slots beyond that count are ignored regardless of their values.

padding.tooltip: Padding around detected face bbox as fraction (0.15 = 15% expansion). Captures hair/neck context for stronger identity preservation.

fallback_bbox.tooltip: Bbox to use if face detection fails or no face is found. Format: 'x1,y1,x2,y2' normalized 0-1. Empty = empty output on fail.

LTXFaceDetector.name: LTXFaceDetector
LTXFaceDetector.description: Detect face in image, emit normalized bbox string. Wire output to LikenessGuide's face_bbox_within_reference, LikenessAnchor's override_face_bbox / frame_0_bbox, or face_anchor's face_bbox_norm. Decouples detection from per-node logic so multiple nodes can share the same bbox.

LTXModelInspector.name: LTXModelInspector
LTXModelInspector.description: Inspect diffusion model: top-level / name-filter / focus_path / trace hooks.

kwargs_to_check.tooltip: Comma-separated kwarg names to check for in the innermost forward() signature. The defaults cover the JoyAI-Echo memory bank kwargs and likely alternative names.

substring_search.tooltip: Comma-separated substrings to search for in forward signature kwarg names (case-insensitive). Any kwarg containing one of these is reported.

max_depth.tooltip: How many .model / .diffusion_model nesting levels to traverse before stopping.

ModelForwardProbe.name: ModelForwardProbe
ModelForwardProbe.description: Inspects a MODEL's class hierarchy and forward signature. Designed to verify whether memory_video / paired_audio_memory (JoyAI-Echo memory bank kwargs) are accepted by the diffusion module's forward — but works for any kwargs check. Output is the input MODEL unchanged + a STRING report. Also prints to console.

zero_ref_timesteps.tooltip: Mark reference tokens as sigma=0 (clean reference). Default OFF based on empirical testing — most LTX2.3 checkpoints (including Echo's released T2V) produce better output when reference tokens share target's noise sigma. Enable only if a checkpoint was trained for clean-reference memory.

verbose.tooltip: Enable detailed per-call logging. Useful for debugging the first time you wire up this node. Disable for normal use to keep the console clean.

LTXReferenceEnable.name: LTXReferenceEnable
LTXReferenceEnable.description: Patches LTX2.3-AV models to accept a reference latent that gets prepended to the video token sequence inside the transformer. Works as a complementary identity-injection mechanism — most useful combined with standard i2v frame_0 latent conditioning. Pair with LTX Reference Conditioning to attach an image. The patches activate only when a reference latent is provided; safe passthrough otherwise.

target_latent.tooltip: Optional. Wire the same LATENT that goes into your sampler. The image will be resized in pixel space to match this latent's spatial dimensions before VAE encoding, guaranteeing memory and target have matching patches-per-frame. Without this, you'll get a tensor mismatch error if your image and target latent don't match exactly.

strength.tooltip: Scales the reference latent magnitude. 1.0 = native VAE output. <1.0 reduces influence; >1.0 boosts (may distort). Set to 0.0 to bypass completely and clear any prior reference state.

position_mode.tooltip: How reference tokens are positioned in the attention sequence. 'reference' (default): tokens overlap target's first frame temporally — uniform identity influence across all generated frames. 'prefix_continuous': tokens placed before target temporally — equivalent to standard i2v prior-context conditioning.

verbose.tooltip: Print detailed per-call info to the console. Useful for debugging. Disable for normal use.

LTXReferenceConditioning.name: LTXReferenceConditioning
LTXReferenceConditioning.description: Encodes an image through the LTX2 video VAE and attaches the resulting latent to the MODEL as a reference for prefix injection during sampling. Requires LTX Reference Enable upstream. Works on any LTX2.3 checkpoint (vanilla, Echo, merged variants). Complementary to standard i2v latent conditioning and existing latent_anchor/likeness_anchor approaches — these are different intervention points and can be combined.

images.tooltip: Multi-frame IMAGE input (a video frame sequence). Use a Load Video, image batch, or upstream frame producer.

target_latent.tooltip: Optional. Wire the same LATENT going to your sampler. Frames will be resized in pixel space to match this latent's spatial dims before VAE encoding.

start_frame.tooltip: Which frame in the input sequence to start the reference window at. Frames before this are discarded.

num_frames.tooltip: How many frames from start_frame to use as reference. Default 9 (1 + 8k matches LTX2 temporal compression — gives ~2 latent frames). 17, 25 also valid for more temporal context at higher cost.

strength.tooltip: Scales the reference latent magnitude. 0.0 bypasses and clears state.

position_mode.tooltip: 'reference': memory positions overlap target's first frames. 'prefix_continuous': memory positions precede target temporally.

verbose.tooltip: Print detailed per-call info to the console.

LTXReferenceSequenceConditioning.name: LTXReferenceSequenceConditioning
LTXReferenceSequenceConditioning.description: Multi-frame variant of LTX Reference Conditioning. Takes a frame-sequence IMAGE input and uses a chosen N-frame window as reference. Multi-frame reference can capture motion and temporal style that single-image reference can't.

LTXReferenceProbe.name: LTXReferenceProbe
LTXReferenceProbe.description: Inspects a MODEL after LTX Reference Enable + Conditioning to verify wiring. Reports patch status, reference latent presence and shape, position mode. Use before the sampler to catch config issues without running a generation.

LTXReferenceBypass.name: LTXReferenceBypass
LTXReferenceBypass.description: Clears any attached reference_latent from MODEL so downstream samplers run without memory injection. Useful between passes — e.g., apply Reference Conditioning for the primary generation pass, then route through Bypass before an upscale tiled sampler where memory isn't needed (and where the first-frame attention to memory tokens can introduce minor distortion).

identity_strength.tooltip: Scales reference latent magnitude. 1.0 = Best-Face-ID default.

face_padding.tooltip: Face bbox expansion — captures hair/neck context.

auto_face_crop.tooltip: When a face is detected, auto-crop the reference image around the face at zoom_factor extent and match target aspect ratio. Dramatically improves identity transfer for wide/full-body references by giving the VAE much more face detail to encode. Turn off if reference is already tightly cropped.

crop_zoom_factor.tooltip: How much context around the face to include. 2.0 = crop is 2x the face bbox (shoulders + hair). 1.5 = very tight (face + hair only). 3.0 = wide (upper body). Ignored if auto_face_crop off.

spatial_gating.tooltip: Constrain identity influence to face region. mask_soft = cosine falloff (recommended). mask_hard = binary. off = uniform (raw Best-Face-ID).

placement_mode.tooltip: i2v_safe / t2v_overlap = pure overlap layout (Best-Face-ID's 'what we use' default). Reference reuses target's coord grid, disambiguated by clean/noisy state and sequence position. prefix = additive offset (legacy).

source_id.tooltip: RoPE source tag applied via v2 phase rotation. Best-Face-ID LoRA expects 2.0. source_id=0 disables rotation (falls back to overlap-only v1 behavior).

phase_scale.tooltip: Phase rotation magnitude multiplier. Best-Face-ID LoRA expects 1.0. Lower values reduce reference/target separation strength.

LTXFaceIdentityReinforcer.name: LTXFaceIdentityReinforcer
LTXFaceIdentityReinforcer.description: Unified LTX-Best-Face-ID identity reinforcer. Combines reference latent injection, RoPE source-phase tagging, face detection, and spatial mask gating in a single node. Makes Best-Face-ID work correctly alongside i2v frame 0 conditioning by placing reference tokens at a distinct RoPE position while preserving the source_id=2 tag the LoRA was trained against. Replaces LikenessAnchor for identity workflows.

output_path.tooltip: Bucket/file this pool accumulates into. Use a distinct path per condition (agree/conflict/dmd_on/dmd_off).

target_filter.tooltip: Regex; a module is captured if its dotted path matches. Note 'attn1' also matches 'audio_attn1' — use exclude_filter to drop the audio stream.

exclude_filter.tooltip: Regex; modules whose path matches are skipped even if target_filter matched. E.g. 'audio_' for video-only, or 'to_gate_logits' to drop gates.

reset.tooltip: Clear this path's accumulator before this pass. Set True on the FIRST prompt of a pool only.

LTXActivationCalibrator.name: LTXActivationCalibrator
LTXActivationCalibrator.description: Accumulates per-layer input E[x^2] during sampling into a named bucket. Pair with LTXCalibratorFlush downstream of the sampler to write the mask.

clear_after_flush.tooltip: Drop the in-memory bucket after writing. Leave False while accumulating a pool.

LTXCalibratorFlush.name: LTXCalibratorFlush
LTXCalibratorFlush.description: Writes a bucket's running-mean E[x^2] mask to a safetensors file. Run after the sampler.

FL_Switch.name: FL_Switch
FL_Switch.description:
FL_Switch allows you to choose between two processing paths based on a switch value.
    The node only evaluates the path that is selected by the switch value.
    
    - If switch = False: on_false is evaluated and returned as output, on_true is not evaluated
    - If switch = True: on_true is evaluated and returned as output, on_false is not evaluated
    
    This node is useful for creating conditional workflows where you want to process data differently based on certain conditions,
    and you only want the selected path to execute.

FL_Switch_Big.name: FL_Switch_Big
FL_Switch_Big.description:
FL_Switch_Big allows you to choose between multiple processing paths based on a switch condition.
    The node only evaluates the path that is selected by the switch condition.
    
    - The switch_condition is compared against each case value
    - If a match is found, the corresponding input is evaluated and returned
    - If no match is found, input_default is evaluated and returned
    - Inputs that don't match the condition are not evaluated
    
    This node is useful for creating conditional workflows with multiple branches.

FL_WanVideoContinue.name: FL_WanVideoContinue
FL_WanVideoContinue.description: Creates a continuation video with symmetrical overlap - uses last N frames from input video at start and first N frames from end video at end.

overlap_frames.tooltip: Number of frames to blend between the two videos using cross-fade.

video_2.tooltip: Second video (will be resized to match video_1).

FL_WanVideoBlender.name: FL_WanVideoBlender
FL_WanVideoBlender.description: Blends two input videos with a cross-fade. The resolution of the second clip is resized to match the first.

overlap_frames.tooltip: Number of frames to blend at each transition point using cross-fade.

video_1.tooltip: First video (reference resolution) - typically your input/start video.

video_2.tooltip: Second video (middle/continuation) - will be resized to match video_1.

video_3.tooltip: Third video (end) - will be resized to match video_1.

FL_WanVideoBlender3Way.name: FL_WanVideoBlender3Way
FL_WanVideoBlender3Way.description: Blends three videos with cross-fade transitions. Perfect for input → continuation → end workflows. All videos resized to match first video.

overlap_frames.tooltip: Number of overlap frames used in FL_WanVideoContinue. Must match the value used to create the continuation video.

video_1.tooltip: First video (reference resolution) - the 'input_video_frames' from FL_WanVideoContinue.

continuation_video.tooltip: The rendered continuation video from FL_WanVideoContinue - has embedded overlaps that will be automatically stripped.

video_2.tooltip: Second video - the 'end_video_frames' from FL_WanVideoContinue. Will be resized to match video_1.

FL_WanVideoContinuationBlender.name: FL_WanVideoContinuationBlender
FL_WanVideoContinuationBlender.description: Blends videos with a continuation video that has embedded overlaps. Automatically strips overlap frames to prevent duplication. Use this after FL_WanVideoContinue.

frame_idx.tooltip: Pixel frame index where the guide starts. LTX video guides snap to the model's latent cadence.

guide_strength.tooltip: Strength for the IC-LoRA guide conditioning.

denoise_strength.tooltip: Maximum denoise mask value applied to masked target latent areas.

attention_strength.tooltip: Strength for the guide attention mask metadata.

mask_mode.tooltip: Choose whether the mask affects latent denoising, guide attention, or both.

inpaint_preprocess.tooltip: Fill masked guide pixels with LTX's inpaint green before VAE encoding.

write_source_to_latent.tooltip: Encode the source image/video into the target latent frames before applying the denoise mask.

latent_downscale_factor.tooltip: Downscale only the IC-LoRA guide latent. The source latent write remains full size.

mask.tooltip: Optional mask for latent denoise, guide attention, and green inpaint preprocessing.

FL_LTXVMaskedICLoRAGuide.name: FL_LTXVMaskedICLoRAGuide
FL_LTXVMaskedICLoRAGuide.description: Adds an image/video as an LTXV IC-LoRA guide. When a mask is connected, it can affect latent denoising, guide attention, or both.

images.description: Batch of images to cycle through on beats

use_black_white.description: Use black/white switching instead of images

width.description: Frame width (images will be resized to this)

height.description: Frame height (images will be resized to this)

start_with_white.description: Start with white instead of black (only for black/white mode)

pattern_sequence.description: Pattern orchestration (e.g., 'A,A,B,B,C,A,A,D'). Letters reference patterns A-D.

repeat_pattern.description: Loop pattern sequence to cover entire song

clamp_output.description: Clamp output to valid range [0,1] to prevent overexposure

edge_frames.description: Pre-computed edge frames (grayscale/mask). If not provided, edges will be auto-detected.

edge_threshold.description: Edge detection sensitivity (only used if edge_frames not provided)

envelope_intensity.description: How much envelope affects glow (0 = static, higher = more reactive)

blend_mode.description: How to blend glow with original

mask.description: Optional mask to control where effect is applied

saturation_intensity.description: Saturation intensity (positive = more saturated on hits, negative = desaturated)

chunk_length.description: Length of each processing chunk in seconds (longer = more memory)

chunk_overlap.description: Overlap between chunks in seconds (higher = smoother)

FL_AnimatedShapePatterns.name: FL_AnimatedShapePatterns
FL_AnimatedShapePatterns.description:
Creates animated geometric shape patterns with various algorithms.
Generates a batch of images with shapes arranged in interesting patterns.

FL_PathAnimator.name: FL_PathAnimator
FL_PathAnimator.description:
Creates animated shapes that follow user-drawn paths.
Open the path editor to draw trajectories on a reference image, then shapes will follow these paths over time.
Outputs WAN ATI-compatible coordinate strings with proper 121-point resampling for stable video generation.

FL_GeminiImageGenADV.description:
Generates images using Gemini based on multiple image/prompt pairs.
Each pair triggers an asynchronous API call. Results are batched.

WorkflowPrettifier.name: WorkflowPrettifier
WorkflowPrettifier.description:
Auto-arrange your workflow nodes.

Layouts: Layered (DAG columns), Linear (single row), Compact (tight rectangle), Sort by Type (group same nodes).

Supports groups, configurable direction, and undo stack (10 deep).

Right-click selected nodes for alignment tools.
